description_en: Invoke LaunchSurvey to send a satisfaction survey. This operation causes the agent to hang up. If it is a voice-based satisfaction survey, the customer enters the IVR satisfaction survey flow after the agent hangs up and completes the satisfaction collection within the IVR flow. If it is an SMS-based satisfaction survey, the call ends and the customer receives a satisfaction survey text message
description_zh: 调用LaunchSurvey发送满意度调查，该操作会导致挂机，如果是语音满意度，客户会在坐席挂机后进入IVR满意度调查流程，并在IVR流程中完成满意度采集。如果是短信满意度，则通话结束，客户收到满意度调查短信
kebab_example: aliyun ccc launch-survey --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --device-id device --job-id job-65804666546490000 --contact-flow-id 4685b65a-eb8f-11ec-8ea0-0242ac120002 --contact-flow-variables '{"customerID":"208880281831****","operateType":"cipherCode","taskId":"1234567890","crmOther":"123"}' --survey-channel IVR --sms-metadata-id 4685b65a-eb8f-11ec-8ea0-0242ac120002 --survey-template-id 19dc793c-9a01-4cb0-b7d5-fcb5431bab6b --survey-template-variables '[]' --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: LaunchSurvey

parameters.help_en: The agent ID that initiates the satisfaction survey
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: Device ID. This parameter has no effect and can be filled with any value
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，无意义，可以随便填写
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.help_en: The contact flow ID of the IVR satisfaction survey flow. Ensure that the specified contact flow ID corresponds to an active satisfaction survey flow
parameters.help_zh: IVR满意度流程的联系流ID，请确保填入的联系流ID是可用的满意度调查流程
parameters.name: contact_flow_id

parameters.help_en: Variables passed to the contact flow. The variables configured here can be retrieved and used in the IVR flow. The format is a JSON string containing a collection of key-value pairs. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty
parameters.help_zh: 传递给联系流的变量，这里配置的变量，可以在IVR流程中拿到并使用，格式为JSON字符串格式的键值对集合，非必填，默认为空
parameters.name: contact_flow_variables

parameters.help_en: The channel for collecting satisfaction feedback. This parameter is optional and defaults to Voice Satisfaction
parameters.help_zh: 满意度采集渠道，非必填，默认为语音满意度
parameters.name: survey_channel

parameters.help_en: The configuration ID for text message satisfaction. This parameter is required only when the collection channel is SMS. It is optional and defaults to empty
parameters.help_zh: 短信满意度配置ID，只有收集渠道为SMS时才需要填写此参数，非必填，默认为空
parameters.name: sms_metadata_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the satisfaction survey template
parameters.name: survey_template_id
